note: Nomination-day report for the thirty-nine electoral divisions of Omagh rural district, one member each. Twenty-three Unionist candidates were nominated and returned unopposed; no nominations were received in the remaining sixteen divisions, whose seats were filled by co-option. There was no contest and no poll. Sole nomination; returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Renamed from 'Dervaghray' to Dervaghroy (19 Nov 2026, w19-tidy, the owner's decision 4 of 19 Nov 2026: a division filed under two spellings takes its official name, and each round keeps the spelling it was filed under as Constituency_Name_As_Printed): the 1911 DED map (Omagh Rural District) and the Northern Ireland DED maps of 1921-69 name the DED Dervaghroy; the rounds were filed as Dervaghray (1924); Dervaghroy (1927, 1933, 1936, 1939, 1946, 1949, 1952, 1955, 1958, 1961, 1964, 1967); Dernaghray (1930). This round was filed as 'Dervaghray', kept as Constituency_Name_As_Printed; the old address (dervaghray) answers with a redirect to this one.
